The '''Commercial District''' was one of the four districts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]]. It was the primary economic center in the city, though by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], its activity was much reduced and more heavily monitered.<ref name="CotG" />
